sentences.pinyin: Míngtiān jiù shì Báilù le, tiānqì mànmàn biàn liáng, qiūtiān zhēn de lái le.
sentences.english: Tomorrow is White Dew. The weather is slowly turning cool, and autumn has truly arrived.

sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang, Xiǎomíng hé māma yìqǐ zhāi lóngyǎn.
sentences.english: In the morning, Xiaoming and his mother picked longans together.

sentences.pinyin: Māma gàosù tā: “Báilù de shíhou chī lóngyǎn, hē chá, shēntǐ huì gèng jiànkāng.”
sentences.english: His mother told him: "Eating longans and drinking tea during White Dew will make your body healthier."

sentences.pinyin: Lóngyǎn yí ge ge yuányuán de, hěn tián.
sentences.english: The longans were round and very sweet.

sentences.pinyin: Māma jiāo Xiǎomíng: “Yào qīngqīng de zhāi, bù néng tài yònglì.”
sentences.english: His mother taught Xiaoming: "You need to pick them gently, don't use too much force."

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng rènzhēn de xué, hěn kuài jiù zhāi le hěn duō lóngyǎn.
sentences.english: Xiaoming learned diligently and soon picked a lot of longans.

sentences.pinyin: Lóngyǎn zhāi wán le, māma kāishǐ pào Báilù chá.
sentences.english: After the longans were picked, his mother started brewing White Dew tea.

sentences.pinyin: Chá pào hǎo le, zhēn xiāng!
sentences.english: The tea was brewed, it smelled so fragrant!

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng xiǎngqǐ Jiàoshījié kuài dào le, tā xiǎng gěi lǎoshī zuò yì zhāng kǎpiàn.
sentences.english: Xiaoming remembered that Teachers' Day was approaching, and he wanted to make a card for his teacher.

sentences.pinyin: Tā yòng zhǐ zuò le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, zài shàngmiàn rènzhēn de xiě: “Lǎoshī, xièxie nín! Zhù nín Jiàoshījié kuàilè!”
sentences.english: He made a card out of paper and carefully wrote on it: "Teacher, thank you! Happy Teachers' Day to you!"

sentences.pinyin: Hái huà le yì bēi chá hé hěn duō lóngyǎn.
sentences.english: He also drew a cup of tea and many longans.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng názhe kǎpiàn wèn māma: “Māma, wǒ kěyǐ bǎ zhè bēi chá sòng gěi lǎoshī ma?”
sentences.english: Xiaoming held the card and asked his mother: "Mom, can I give this cup of tea to the teacher?"

sentences.pinyin: Māma xiàozhe shuō: “Dāngrán kěyǐ! Lǎoshī yídìng huì hěn gāoxìng.”
sentences.english: His mother smiled and said: "Of course you can! The teacher will definitely be very happy."

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: “Wǒ juéde lǎoshī jiù xiàng māma yíyàng, duì wǒmen tèbié hǎo.”
sentences.english: Xiaoming said: "I think the teacher is just like Mom, exceptionally good to us."

sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: “Nǐ zhēn shì ge hǎo háizi.”
sentences.english: His mother said: "You are truly a good child."

sentences.pinyin: Dì'èrtiān zǎoshang, Xiǎomíng dàizhe kǎpiàn hé yì bēi rè chá qù xuéxiào, bǎ lǐwù sòng gěi lǎoshī: “Lǎoshī, Jiàoshījié kuàilè! Zhè shì Báilù chá, hē le shēntǐ huì gèng jiànkāng.”
sentences.english: The next morning, Xiaoming took the card and a cup of hot tea to school and gave the gift to his teacher: "Teacher, Happy Teachers' Day! This is White Dew tea, drinking it will make your body healthier."

sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī kàn le kàn kǎpiàn, hē le chá, xiào de hěn kāixīn: “Xièxie nǐ, Xiǎomíng! Kǎpiàn hěn hǎokàn, chá yě hěn hǎohē.”
sentences.english: The teacher looked at the card, drank the tea, and smiled happily: "Thank you, Xiaoming! The card is beautiful, and the tea is delicious too."

sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang, tiānqì hěn liángkuai, Xiǎomíng hé jiārén yìqǐ zuò zài wàimiàn, yì biān chīzhe tiántián de lóngyǎn, yì biān hēzhe Báilù chá.
sentences.english: In the evening, the weather was cool and pleasant. Xiaoming and his family sat outside, eating sweet longans while drinking White Dew tea.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng juéde, jīntiān shì zuì kuàilè de yì tiān.
sentences.english: Xiaoming felt that today was the happiest day.
